title: WIRT LINES UP
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K gambler screenshot. At Wirt the GAMBLE box was a narrow box only as wide as its one line and its button, and the LIMITED TIME OFFER box under it was about two and a half times wider, so the two centred boxes had no edge in common and the window looked unfinished. Both boxes are now the same width and stack as one neat column. Nothing in them changed.
now: At Wirt the gamble box and the offer box are now the same width.
